paragraphs: The webinar attracted 133 registrants with 74 attendees (55.6% attendance), yielding 31 post‑event engaged contacts, 12 MQL+ and 9 SQL+ (attendee‑to‑MQL 16.2%). Five accounts show buying‑committee coverage, led by Palmetto SaaS Group (score 201.5, 9 engaged contacts, 90% committee coverage), Anchorpoint SaaS (score 107, 7 contacts, 87.5% coverage), and Truenorth Ecommerce (score 83.5, 4 contacts, 100% coverage).

Two compressed‑activity anomalies surfaced: a contact generated 21 of 26 touches on 2026‑08‑07 (80.8% of their activity) yet their lifecycle stage never advanced, flagging a stalled hot lead that merits a manual RevOps review; another contact logged 17 of 27 touches on 2026‑07‑25 (63% of activity) and their lifecycle stage already reflects the engagement, requiring no immediate action.
